source: src/lib/bunny-host/voice/voice-fsm.ts (VOICE_TRANSITIONS, generated from the live module)

states.meaning: Session open; microphone closed; nothing playing.
Capture requested; device not yet confirmed open.
Worker confirmed capture.started on a real (or labelled fixture) device.
Final transcript accepted (confidence-gated); answer being produced or awaiting first playback.
Worker confirmed playback.started for the current generation.
Playback cancelled by the user (speak.cancel); transient, next turn available.
Microphone muted (snapshot.muted authoritative); no capture possible.
Worker/engine error; capture and playback truth cleared.
Capture refused truthfully: ENDPOINT_MUTED, PERMISSION_DENIED, DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE/BUSY/LOST.

truthRules.capturing: state===LISTENING && worker confirmed capture.started for the current turn/gen
truthRules.playing: state===SPEAKING && worker confirmed playback.started for the current gen
truthRules.closed: open=false: no worker process, no device handles; capturing=false, playing=false

staleSuppression: worker events with gen < current generation or turn != current turn are dropped and counted (lateEventsDropped); a voice.listen.end bound to an older turn is ignored
